translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Mina Iesusmo Pailatna out naaŋgɨra larua wɨtɨkatna
Karica auŋa laruatke, taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa Iudananta ramtaɨr paŋainda muruŋa, mina Iesusa mo menacna kam leacatna.
Ri, mina mamo lawirta ŋgatɨk mbuŋa leaca, mamo aŋgɨca taŋca Pailatna para tɨkrinan. Na Pailat, ma Iudiana pitrik waŋna ramoot paŋan aniac.
Iudasa mamenacat

Ainda moca Iudasa ma Iesusmo puŋnaŋgepta para tɨkrina ramtaɨrmo watri, mina Iesusmo tɨpemb ŋgorikca moca, mamo makuk neaŋgatke, Iudasa ndona iro inik ŋgetrikica, ma an taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa, Iudiana ramtaɨr paŋainda, mamo neaŋrina 30na mɨnna silwana kitukndukarmo ma aŋgɨca minmo nda neaŋgatna.

Ri, ma aindopatna, “Gan ramootta aku nena para tɨkrinan, ma tɨp ŋgoreacna makuk ianna mba mori. Na ne mana mo menacna mamoek. Aku tɨp ŋgoreacna makukca mamoat.” Na mina mana kamma rutica aindopatna, “Anna aina reaca wanaiŋ, anna una reac, u ndo wandoŋai.”
Aindopatke, ma an silwana kitukndukarmo Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kac inikca ke irikca, ma laruca taŋga kaorikca mamenacat.

Karica taup ndamtaɨr paŋainda, an silwana kitukndukar aŋgɨca, mina gaindopatna, “Gan silwana kitukndukar puŋga anna ramootna racaindpaik ŋgoikrinan. Aintik aia mamo an Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kacna kitukndukarap kai tɨk teac.”

Ri, mina kam leaca, an silwana kitukndukarmo mina aŋgɨca wɨnneca morena ramtaɨrta pitrik umbum maoikat. Te, an pitrik umbummo mina kabena tawanna auŋna meikramtaɨra menac te, mina warirmo anna mutocna.
Aintik an mɨnna mina an pitrik umbummo gan i neaŋgatna, Racaindpaikna Pitrik Umbum. Na mina manmo aind ŋgacrena.

Ainda moca atua Raraŋ Aetaniaca ndona ramma morina ramoot Ieremaina upa tɨkrina kam ianna ma moa mɨnna tɨkrina. Na an kamma gaindoprina, “Israelna ramtaɨr ndeida mina an 30na mɨnna kitukndukarmo kam leaca aindoprina, an kitukndukara anna an ramootmo oikna mɨn.
Aintik an silwana kitukndukarmo mina wɨnna morena ramootna tiacarpaikna tiacar tɨp paik ŋgoikrina. Anna Kacootta mbopatna kirar.”
Pailatta Iesusmo gainda digiatna, u Iudananta gagrirta ramoot paŋan ki
Na Iesusa ma Iudiananta ramoot paŋan Pailatna outta wɨtɨkca eacri. Na ma manmo gainda digiatna, “U Iudananta gagrirta ramoot paŋan ki?” Ri, Iesusa rutica aindopatna, “U ande mambopri.”
Ainda moca taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindap Iudana ramtaɨr paŋainda, mamo ndoŋrapaca, paparuna kamb topri, ma mina kambca mba rutiri.
Na ma manmo gaind mac digiatna, “Na mina umo kekelamun kerena kambca u mba waracre ki?”
Na ma, mana kam ianna mba rutiri. Ainda moca Pailatta tamtam ŋgoin malamŋiat.
Pailatta Iesusmo ik naaŋgɨca keracna kam ndopatna

Na an amtiamna ra aniaca Iudiananta bubuocrena ramoot paŋanna, ma kac ŋgoreac ndeacrena ramoot ianmo wattacarica larurena. Ainda moca meikramtaɨra, ndori puŋga an kac ŋgoreac ndeacrena ramootna i ŋgac te, an ramoot paŋanna, ma an ramootmo watcarica ma larunande.
Na an mɨnna, macmakɨmapa runduŋna tɨp ŋgoreaca morina irembta ramoot ianna ma toco kac ŋgoreaca eacrina. Na mana ia, Barabas.

Ainda moca meikramtaɨra kɨpca puniatke, Pailatta minmo gainda digiatna, “Ne toŋgorinanna, aku mandaimo, watcarica laruit? Aku Barabas, co an Iesusa mina aindoprena, Raraŋ Aetaniaca babuca mbagɨrica kɨpca aimo mac nda aŋgɨna ramootmo, watcarica laruit ki?”
Na ma aindopatnanna, ma lamŋirina, mina Iesusmo iroar ŋgorikapa nikembkakaitap, na mina manmo aŋgɨca kɨpca ma mamo ritri waparaca mona.

Na ma an ritri waparacna mbibiracna taupca mbiraca eacri, mana meaca manmo kam ian neaŋga kɨpca aindopatna, “U an ramoot wandoŋmo reac ianna kai mo teac, mouŋa aku mamo tamram mbuŋa watca, aukna iro inikca laŋa mba eacreke.”
Ainda mori, taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa Iudiana ramtaɨr paŋainda mina meikramtaɨrta iroara moa ŋgepca, mina Pailatmo aca mbop te, ma Barabasa watcarica laru te, Iesusmo mo menacna.
Karica an Iudiana ramoot paŋanna minmo gaind mac digiatna, “Ne toŋgorinanna aku an ramootniŋmo mandai ŋgoinna watcarica laruit?” Ri, mina muruŋa aca aindopatna, “Barabas.”

Aindopatke, ma minmo gainda digiatna, na an Iesusa mina aindoprinanna, Raraŋ Aetaniaca babuca mbagɨrica kɨpca aimo mac nda aŋgɨna ramootmo, kaica moit? Ri, mina muruŋa aca aindopatna, “Mamo ik naaŋgɨ kerac.”
Ri, Pailatta minmo digiatna, “Kaica? Ma kaina reaca moa ŋgocrairinan?” Ri, mina gagraca aca aindopatna, “Mamo ik naaŋgɨ kerac.”

Ainda moca ma malamŋiat, mina mana kammo mba waracitndai, na runduŋ aniaca ŋgepna mamoek. Ri, ma puk aŋgɨca ma ndona parniŋmo mina lamnɨac ŋgoutta tɨkca tukica, ma aindopatna, “An ramootta menac te, anna aukna makukca wanaiŋ, anna nena reac.”
Aintik an meikramtaɨra muruŋa mana kammo rutica aindopatna, “An makukca aiapa aina mombonikap eacnande.”

Ainda mori, ma Barabasmo wattacarica ma laruca min ndambuŋa taŋgatke, ma mbopca mina Iesusmo lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨrta para tɨkca, mina mamo ruktuk mbuŋa pirina. Na iŋmbaia mina manmo aŋgɨca taŋca ik nakeracnandet.
Lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨra Iesusmo pepereatna
Karica lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨra Iesusmo aŋgɨca mina aiŋa morena kaca mbukatke, mina an lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨrmo muruŋa aca kɨprinan.
Ri, mina mana tik ŋgapaocmo pitukca, mamo tik ŋgapaoc laup ian mac maaocat.

Karica mina kun tocna ŋgatɨk aŋgɨca, an mbuŋa gagrirta ramootna paŋanna tɨkrena reaca moca, mana paŋan matɨkat. Na mana par umbaimo, ruktuk ianna neaŋga mautiŋgat. Ri, mina mana outmo tutpemb rɨmbɨtca manmo peperena kam mbuŋa aindopatna, “Ra laŋ, Iudana gagrirta ramoot paŋan.”
Ri, mina manmo taber iurina, na mamo neaŋrina ruktuk mbuŋa mana paŋanmo an mbuŋa pica, mac piatna.
Karica mina manmo ainda moa maiatke, mina an tik ŋgapaoca mana tikca tɨkatnan nda riaŋga, mana tik ŋgapaoc ŋgoin matɨkat. Ri, mina mamo ik naaŋgɨ keracna moca aŋgɨca mataŋgat.
Mina Iesusmo aŋgɨra ik makeracat
Ainda moca mina mamo aŋgɨca laruca taŋgatke. Lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨra watrinanna, Sairinina auŋna ramoot ian, na mana ia Saimon. Mina man aŋgɨca, mamo moca ma Iesusna keracna ik mambukat.
Ri, mina taŋga taup ian malaruat, na mana ia Golgota. Na an ina mɨnɨŋa gaind, Paŋan Tiaŋgapna Gagarna taup.
Na anna tɨkca, mina manmo wain pukca mina kabena roumbca rorairena niŋniŋna reacap kurica manmo neaŋamna. Na ma amna towairina, na ma mba ambatke.
Karica an lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨra mamo ik naaŋgɨa keracatke, mina matɨp rocotna gegerei toca gereica watna, mandaia ndo mana tik ŋgapoikmo aŋgɨit.
Ainda mori, mina anna mbiraca mana ŋginaŋ mamori.
Na mana keracrina ikmo, mina mana paŋanna tamuŋmbaia, mina manmo ritri waparaca morina kam tɨp ianna, anna mina gainda tirca tikatna, “Gan Iesus, Ma Iudananta Gagrirta Ramoot Paŋan.”
Karica mina mana roumbmo, mina macmakɨmna ramootniŋa anna tɨkca makeracat. Na ianna mana aeŋmbaina parna ik nakeracri, na ianmo mana umbaina parna ik makeracat.
Ri, meikramtaɨra taŋ, kɨp tɨkri, mina mamo peperena kamb ŋgorik toprina, na ndorita paŋaindmo korererina.
Na mina mamo aindopatna, “U Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kacmo waŋarca, rai mbonkacna inikca u mac monandet. Na u Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc ecte, u ndomo otaca, an ik nakeraca eacrenanmo, tɨkcarica irik.”
Ainda moca taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa tɨpemb wandik tamŋirena ramtaɨrapa ramtaɨr paŋaind, mitoco mamo pepereca aindopatna,
“Ma kabena meikramtaɨrmo otacrina, na ma ndomo otacna mɨnna wanaiŋ. Na ma Israelna Gagrirta Ramoot Paŋan, ma keracrina ikca tɨkcarica irik te, aia manmo rɨpacnandet.
Na ma Raraŋ Aetaniacmo rɨpaca aindoprina, ‘Aku Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc.’ Na Raraŋ Aetaniaca mamo toŋgo te, mandeaca ma manmo otacna.”
Karica an macmakɨmapa tɨpemb ŋgorikca morina ramootniŋa, mina Iesusna roumbniŋa keraca eacrinanna, maniŋ toco manmo an pepere wɨtna kambta kirar kabe mambopat.
Iesusa mamenacat
Na maica rana ŋgaŋganŋgɨa ga aŋgɨa rɨmbɨŋa rɨŋgatke, gan tiacarpaikca neaupa muruŋa wɨŋga kɨtaca, taŋca rana ŋgaŋganŋgɨa mbonkacna mɨn.

Ainda moca rana ŋgaŋganŋgɨa mbonkaca mona rambuŋairi, Iesusa kam aniaca keca gaindopatna, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Na an kamna mɨnɨŋa gaind, “Aukna Raraŋ Aetaniac, Aukna Raraŋ Aetaniac kaina moca u aukmo tɨkcaririna?”
Ri, ramtaɨr ndeida rambuŋa wɨtɨkca eacrinanna, mina an kamma waraca, mina aindopatna, “Gan ramootta ma Elaiana maacreke.”

Na tawi ŋgoinna mina ianna ootta taŋga puk wɨŋga utiŋrena reac, mina spans ŋgacrena ian aŋgɨca ma ambrina mambarina wain pukca tɨkca, ma upniŋa tɨkri, ma ik tɨp ianna tɨkca leaca, mamo neaŋamna mamori.
Na ndeida aindopatna, “Pac lambi, aia pac wat. Moca Elaia kɨpca, mamo otacit ki, co wanaiŋ?”
Ainda mori, ma kam aniac ŋgoin makeat, mana ŋeroŋa putrikica ma mamenacat.
Ainda moatke, Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kacna tɨŋa mboraca keraca eacrina raraŋitta tamuŋa tɨkca titaca pɨkɨn ŋgirikca, waŋniŋ malaruat. Na gan tiacarpaikca numnum aniaca mori, watur anikca witkica irikri.
Ri, warirta mukura gootca, Raraŋ Aetaniacna meikramtaɨr rat ndeida mac nda ŋgeprina.
Ainda mori, Iesusa ŋgepatna ra, mina Ierusalem auŋ aniaca mbukatke, meikramtaɨr wɨtta watatna.
Ri, an lapoca ruŋrena ramoot paŋanap mana lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨra Iesusna ŋginaŋa mori, mina an reikapa numnum aniaca watca, mina rugdar moca aindopatna, “Gidik ŋgoin, ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc!”
Na meik wɨt toco, mana raŋgaica Galili tɨkcarica kɨpca mamo otacrinan, mitoco tawancait motemma wɨtɨkca an mbatrina.
Na an meikta inikca, Maria, Makdala auŋna meacapa Maria Iemisapa Iosepna aem, na ianna ma Sebedina nuocniŋna aem.
Iesusna waɨra mamutocat
Karica ra maica wigwacmbai mbuŋa Arimatia auŋna lamin aniacna ramoot ianna makɨpri. Na mana ia Iosep, na ma Iesusna iŋa raŋgairena ramoot ian.
Ri, ma taŋga Pailatmo laruca, ma Iesusna waɨr aŋgɨca mutocna madigiat. Na ma mana waɨr aŋgɨna kammo laŋ ndop te, minmo mbopca mina mamo watcarica ma aŋgɨna.
Ainda moca ma mana waɨrmo aŋgɨca ma mamatauat. Ma raraŋit gogok ŋgam ian aŋgɨca man mbuŋa tamairinan.

Karica ma an waɨrmo aŋgɨca taŋga, ma ndo ŋgoinna ndona waɨra anna mutoc ndoprina wautna inik matɨkat. Na an mukna taupca ma mbopa mina moatna. Ri, ma an mukna tɨŋmo mana mboracrena wautmo, rukica mboracarica, ma mataŋgat.
Na Makdala auŋna Mariaapa mana i kabea, maniŋa mukmo raekmbaina roumbca mbiraca mawatri.
Lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨra mukna ŋginaŋa moatna
Ainda moca an Wɨktɨtɨkna amna reac ŋgobacna ra maiatke. Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra, taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa Parisina ramtaɨra mina Pailatta watna mataŋgat.
Karica mina taŋga mamo aindopatna, “Ramoot paŋan, an paparuna ramoot mbopatna kam ianna, ma menac ŋgocor ndeacri, ma gaindopatna, ‘Rai mbonkac mai te, aku mac ŋgepnande.’

Aintik u mbopca mina mana mukmo ŋginaŋa matau watti, taŋi rai mbonkacna mɨn. Moca mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra kɨpca mana waɨrmo makɨm aŋgɨa taŋ te, aindopnande, ‘Ma muk ndiŋ mac ŋgepatna.’ Te, an mandeacna paparuna kamma, ma an ŋgaua Iesusa mbopatna paparuna kammo kunnandet.”

Karica Pailatta minmo gaindopatna, “Ne, lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨrmo aŋgɨca taŋca minmo mbopca mina an mukna ŋginaŋa mo. Aintik ne taŋca an mukna ŋginaŋa mona reikca matau moca, an mukca ma gargar ŋgoin ndeacna.”
Aindopatke, mina taŋga mukmo mataua mboraca muptoca tɨkca. Mina lapoca ruŋrena ramtaɨrmo mbopca, mina man ndambuŋa wɨtɨkca mana ŋginaŋa morina.

footnotes.text: Na an wain puk niŋniŋa. Anna kocna reaca wanaiŋ.
